description.en: Masks names, emails, phones and other personal details in what you send, then puts them back in the answer you see. Detection runs on your Mac — nothing leaves with the real values.
description.zh-hans: 把你要发出去的姓名、邮箱、电话等个人信息先换成假值，收到回答后再换回来。识别只在你这台 Mac 上跑，真值不会跟着发出去。

description.en: The same real value always becomes the same fake one, so a follow-up question still makes sense. Turn off to forget between sessions.
description.zh-hans: 同一个真值永远换成同一个假值，这样追问时语义还对得上。关掉之后，下次启动就不再沿用上一次的映射。
